name: WLED Remote (with Kids mode)
author: Cody Patten
description: A phone remote for FPP 10.3+: run FPP's built-in WLED effects on your xLights props and groups, start and stop playlists, save presets, and hand the kids a simple PIN-locked Kids mode with a color wheel and big picture buttons.

privacy.summary: A page served by FPP itself that talks only to this FPP. It loads nothing from the internet and sends nothing anywhere.
privacy.other: Saves presets and Kids-mode settings as two JSON files in FPP's config folder (fpp-wled-remote-presets.json and fpp-wled-remote-kids.json). Kids' favorites are kept in each phone's browser.
